question: Who among the following was the chief guest at India's 74th Republic Day celebrations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdel Fattah El-Sisi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **chief guest **at India's** 74th Republic Day **celebrations was **Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, the President of Egypt.**
 
• He was invited as a special guest to **strengthen the bilateral ties** between **India and Egypt.**
 
• This was his first visit to India since he took office in **2014.**
 
• During his visit, several **agreements were signed** between the two countries in the areas of **defence, trade, and culture.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Francois Hollande **is the **former President of France** and was the chief guest at** India's Republic Day celebrations in 2016.**
 
• **Cyril Ramaphosa** is the **President of South Africa** and was the chief guest at India's **Republic Day celebrations in 2019.**
 
• **Jair Bolsonaro i**s the** President of Brazil **and was invited as a chief guest at India's Republic Day celebrations in **2020**.
